Equipped with 32GB of dedicated video memory, it lets you tackle larger, more complex projects without limits. Purpose-built to accelerate AI workloads locally, Radeon™ AI PRO R9600D turns your ambitions into reality with the speed and capacity your workflow demands.
Optimal VRAM Buffer for Advanced Local AI
Meet the memory demands of modern LLMs and text-to-image models on your desktop with AMD Radeon™ AI PRO R9600D Graphics featuring 32GB of VRAM.
PUSH BEYOND DESKTOP LIMITS
Unlocks lightning-fast data transfers and open a pathway to easy multi-GPU scalability with PCIe® Gen 5 support. Designed specifically for AI developers who need to run large models locally, AMD Radeon™ AI PRO R9600D eliminates cloud dependencies, handles the most memory-intensive workloads, and scales with your needs.

XFX 2 Year Warranty
Even though we trust that our high quality products will continue working at peak performance well beyond the use of it, we want to put our word behind that promise. That is why we offer our 2 Year Warranty with this series of graphics cards.
